Procedural Graphics: Noise, Fractals and Mathematical Art
Jun 30, 2026Techniques such as Perlin noise, Worley noise, L-systems, fractals, and cellular automata allow creators to generate terrains, organic forms, particle fields, and abstract art with mathematical precision and surprising variety. The demoscene's relentless size constraints and real-time demands have driven decades of innovation.
